Container.Name: mtg-sorter
Container.Overview: Scans Magic: The Gathering cards with your phone's or computer's camera (or from photos), looks each one up, and keeps your collection, decks, bins, wishlist and prices in one place. Open it from any device on your network. For the phone camera, turn on Tailscale Serve on this container so it has an https address.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: The port the app answers on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Card database, collection, settings and backups.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: For the times shown in History.

Config.Name: Sorter's Pi
Config.Description: The sorter Pi's address, e.g. http://10.0.0.247:5000. The Machine page here then moves the Pi's servos and feeder. Leave empty if there's no sorter.

Config.Name: Sorter's Pi key
Config.Description: Only if the Pi has a PIN or accounts on: the key `mtg machine-key` prints on the Pi.
